caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with a wide, curved brim rendered in yellow and light brown tones with a braided or woven texture pattern. A border of the bonnet features a checkered ribbon in alternating squares of red, turquoise blue, and white with black divisions. Attached to the right side of the bonnet, near the base of the brim, are several long ribbons: two are checkered like the border, and two are solid black. The checked ribbons drape and curve downward in the composition, crossing over the black ribbons. At the point where the ribbons emerge, there is a bow or rosette made from the same checkered ribbon. Near the lower left of the drawing, there is a smaller, unfinished sketch of the same bonnet in black outline, showing its general shape and placement of ribbons. The entire drawing is set within a simple rectangular border, and the signature "Frank Nelson" appears at the lower right corner. The background is plain and off-white.
title: Bonnet
